text:
sam_oncall: 🚨 Seeing a sustained uptick in GPU Xid/ECC errors across two racks in us-west2, capacity drop ~17% and canary jobs are timing out.
anya_infra: I've got the alert graph — error-rate spike started ~12:04 UTC, correlated with increased cold-start latency.
liam_runtime: Canary rollout (v2.3.1) failing with `gpu-init-failed` on node pools gw-usw2-5/6, logs show repeated Xid 13 followed by ECC warnings.
rebecca_sre: Any pattern on kernels? ECC usually indicates memory faults, could be flaky cards or power/thermal.
ira_ops: Quick check: autoscaler tried to add 6 nodes but GCE quota limits prevented provisioning, so backlog grew.
sam_oncall: Stack trace excerpt: ```kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID 2345, Threaded interrupts```. Also repeated `ECC error detected on GPU 3` in dmesg.
anya_infra: I've cordoned gw-usw2-5 to stop new pods and started draining non-critical workloads. Will keep model route traffic away.
liam_runtime: Can we flip routing to fallbacks? We should send production traffic to dedicated predictions in us-central while we triage.
rebecca_sre: Agree. Liam, can you trigger fallback routing and hold canary rollouts?
liam_runtime: On it — `curl -X POST /route/fallback -d '{"region":"us-central","weight":1.0}'` and pausing canary. deploy-bot: Canary pause requested by liam_runtime — returning status: OK.
ira_ops: I've opened a support case with the cloud provider, attaching kernel logs and ECC dumps. Case ID: CSP-82417. Mentioning hardware replacement request.
sam_oncall: Good. We should prepare replacement plan: cordon -> drain -> power-cycle -> reprobe -> replace if flapping. Any objections?
anya_infra: No objections. Also we should blacklist affected PCI bus IDs in our scheduler for 24h to avoid noisy nodes. Adding blacklist action to the drain runbook.
liam_runtime: Observed that KV cache hit rate dropped 9% during the spike, which explains token-cost increase. We'll enable cache-warming for fallback pool to reduce cold-starts.
rebecca_sre: Note on troubleshooting: check fan curves + power rails on the two racks — thermal throttling sometimes triggers soft ECC. Ops, can you get sensor dumps?
ira_ops: Requesting sensor dump now. Command used on node: `sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,fan.speed --format=csv` — results show GPU temps ~84-89C on problematic cards.
sam_oncall: That's high but not catastrophic. Could be dust / degraded airflow. We'll schedule rack-level maintenance if replacement isn't immediate.
anya_infra: Proposing we proactively schedule rolling replacements for the 4 most error-prone units (error_count>50 last 6h). If cloud replacement lead time > 24h we'll drain and reprovision capacity in another region.
liam_runtime: Cost note: moving steady traffic to us-central increases egress/cross-region costs; estimate +$4k/day while we have backlog. Worth it to preserve SLOs.
rebecca_sre: Agreed to accept short-term cost hit. Prioritize user-facing latency SLOs.
ira_ops: Infra-bot just posted automated check results: ``health-check: failed_gpus=4, avg_xid_rate=3.7/min, drained_pods=24``
infra-bot: auto-rollback: no (manual hold), maintenance_window_suggested: 2026-03-19T02:00Z
sam_oncall: Action items: 1) Anya to continue cordon/drain for identified nodes. 2) Ira to push sensor dumps + hardware support ticket. 3) Liam to flip routing and enable cache-warm for fallback. 4) Rebecca to monitor SLOs and coordinate incident comms.
anya_infra: Starting cordon/drain batch A (nodes gw-usw2-5{0..3}) now, ETA 18m. Will post progress.
liam_runtime: Routing switched; traffic to us-central at 85%, fallback cache-warm script running.
rebecca_sre: Monitoring: 95th p50 latency improving but still slightly above target for API-heavy routes. Keeping incident page updated.
ira_ops: Sensor dumps uploaded to CSP case, asked for expedited hardware RMA for 4 cards. Also scheduling rack-level airflow inspection for tomorrow.
sam_oncall: Thanks all. Please post short updates only — keep replies minimal. I’ll consolidate for an incident summary after replacements start. :thumbsup:
